findings.finding_text: The dual-requirement seam's \"documentId\":\"m23-prime- limb is unreachable in honest output: the gateway returns documentId as a sibling of the text, the extension client lifts only the text, frameAsData JSON-quotes the text only — the limb fails every honest green round after full spend.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Verified against sanitize.ts frameAsData + kg-recall client.ts; limb swapped to the frameAsData header literal UNTRUSTED RECALLED DATA (kg_recall), task text pinned to require quoting it.

findings.finding_text: The roster-check preflight spawns with the STAGED TMP path, which loadRoster's repo-root confinement always refuses (exit 1) — the gate blocks every round pre-spend.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: --roster now targets the in-repo fixture (same bytes proven by the sha-bound compare); per the DoD letter, ANY nonzero exit now refuses the round.

findings.finding_text: Empty-baseline guard conflates L1-threw with a genuinely empty listing — false red with a misleading diagnosis on a green round.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: hashesBefore is now a Set|undefined sentinel: undefined = unmeasured (problem), Set = measured (even empty).

findings.finding_text: Unguarded fleetLeftovers/keyLeakProblems in L3's finally can abort the cleanup chain, skipping the unskippable battery, the evidence write, and settleRun.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Block wrapped in try/catch pushing a problem line.

findings.finding_text: The worker_output seam asserted structured fields (result.summary/output) without validating the envelope shape; brittle against driver nesting.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Matching now runs on the raw payload text (structure-agnostic); both limbs are plain substring checks on payloadText.

findings.finding_text: LD degrade control drops evidence-write problems when the body also fails.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Composite rethrow with cause, same shape as L1/L2.

findings.finding_text: Torn [kg-recall] lines discard their computed control-char observation, letting the hygiene rollup read vacuously true.
findings.label: LOW

findings.finding_text: Worst-case spend is printed but not persisted in the spend evidence phase (Observability Contract: worst-case pre-fire + actual).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: worstCaseMicroUsd computed from the leg-sum ceiling and recorded in the memory-live.spend evidence.

findings.finding_text: QDS_EXEDEV_ROSTER enforced-present but never consumed on the dispatch arm (drift from story prose).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Charter §2.1 requires the env present (liveGate checks it); consumption is harness-arm-only by landed design (dispatch derives dirname(manifest)/roster.yaml) — disclosed in the test header; changing the dispatch arm is another story's surface.

findings.finding_text: CLI scrub gate may false-positive on its own published identifiers; CLI happy path untested.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Checked: mintedTokenIds and cleanup records carry sha256 hex, never mgrun- material; memgate log entries are redacted by INV-MG-5 — no mgrun- literal reaches the payload. The CLI's parts are each tested (env-gate spawn test, battery direct tests); the wrapper adds no untested logic.

findings.finding_text: RecallRow.runId === requestId is an unvalidated field-naming assumption.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Verified: M1.2's round asserts the same correlation and the kg-context writer binds row.runId = requestId (kg-context.ts writeRecallRow); round-1 auditor verified the row shape.

findings.finding_text: Roster-check spawn-failure (exitCode null) folds into the proceed arm.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Subsumed by R3-002: any nonzero (null included) now refuses.
